If future logs show Waller’s appearance was actually on a public Fed calendar available at the open, the “unscheduled” classification is wrong and the category becomes a data/calendar coverage failure. Additionally, the model must reconcile its narrative direction with the pipeline-computed total_score before submission — if the narrative says "up/mild" but the components sum to a flat call, the model must either adjust the components to match the narrative or adjust the narrative to match the components.
